today.look_for: Two affordances on every result row (body opens the sheet, trailing + adds at once); Recent is hidden while typing and sits below the camera rows when idle; the sheet still fills its CTA with accent green, which the design system reserves for state.

directions.name: 1A Recents up front
directions.look_for: The re-buy strip sits under the field where the thumb lands, a tap adds and the toast carries Change; the camera rows keep their place and nothing scrolls.

directions.name: 1B Browse, don't type
directions.look_for: A keyboard-free path: Recent rows, then all twelve category tiles with their catalog counts; the price is visible too — the Scan and Snap rows have sunk below the fold.

directions.name: 1C Tap adds, pencil edits
directions.look_for: One row, one meaning: tapping Milk committed it with its suggested shelf and the toast offers Change; the trailing glyph is now a pencil that opens the sheet first, and only the free-text row still leads with the sheet.

today.look_for: The camera card owns the screen; a scan is a haptic and a count, and the staged list lives on a second screen behind Review.

directions.name: 2A Queue under the viewfinder
directions.look_for: The staged rows are the review: they queue under a shorter camera, newest first, an unknown barcode is named by tapping it, and Add 4 to pantry commits from here (held while a row needs a name).

directions.name: 2B Set the shelf first
directions.look_for: A destination is chosen once on the viewfinder (Auto is the default) and every following scan is stamped with it; the count names the mode so a forgotten Freezer cannot go unnoticed.

directions.name: 2C Result card, camera stays live
directions.look_for: Each scan answers with the fact worth checking — name, shelf and estimate on a card over the bottom third with Change and dismiss — while the camera keeps scanning above it.

screen: Receipt / photo capture (camera-first, AI parse, quota meter)

today.look_for: Camera-first: the viewfinder with its Receipt/Groceries switch, Photos and PDF beside the shutter, and one meter line; the shot goes to a preview whose Scan button is the tap that spends a scan.

directions.name: 3A Long receipt as parts
directions.look_for: Each shutter press shrinks into a Part thumbnail and the camera stays live for the next section; the PDF corner becomes Scan 2 parts, so a long receipt is one Scan and one charge.

directions.name: 3B The shutter is the gate
directions.look_for: No preview screen: the frame freezes for 2.5 s behind Sending… Undo, nothing leaves the phone until the window closes, and earlier shots queue as chips (7 items · Reading… · Couldn’t read · Retry); the privacy promise moves under the meter.

directions.name: 3C Reading happens in the basket
directions.look_for: After Scan there is no held analyzing screen — the viewfinder is live again with one toast and the meter already charged; the wait moves to the Add tab’s basket bar (“Reading receipt… · 2 staged”) and to a Reading… skeleton section at the top of the review that fills in place. Note the toast lands where Toast always lands — over the shutter row — so the build would need to lift it.

screen: Capture review list (grouped cells, per-row location/expiry, bulk tick, add all)

today.look_for: One flat list: every row carries a location chip and an expiry tag, Put everything in… acts on all rows regardless of the ticks, and any fix beyond location means opening the editor sheet.

directions.name: 4A Swipe-through ticks and a selection bar
directions.look_for: One drag down the checkbox column unticks a run (Bananas, Sourdough); because the ticked set now differs from all, a selection bar appears above the CTA — Put 3 in… · Remove 3 — and Clear has moved into the header’s ellipsis menu.

directions.name: 4B Grouped by shelf
directions.look_for: The shelf is read, not opened: rows sit under Fridge · 4 and Pantry · 2 with an All to… per section, the location chip is gone, Bananas is mid-drag from Fridge into the highlighted Pantry group, and the unsure row offers Try: “Butter” from the parser’s candidates.

directions.name: 4C Fix in place
directions.look_for: Every attention reason is fixed where it sits: the unnamed barcode row is an inline field with the keyboard, the unsure row offers Keep · Find in catalog instead of a caption, and a last cell adds a line the scan missed; the chevron still opens the editor for notes and category.
